event_summary: A blue round object and a yellow round object move toward each other on a tabletop, touch near the middle, then move apart and become still at opposite sides.
raw_event_description: The video begins with a light wooden tabletop visible and black cylindrical objects partly visible at the left and right edges. For several frames no colored moving objects are visible. A small blue round object then enters from the left side while a small yellow round object enters from the right side. The two colored objects travel toward each other across the tabletop, meet and touch near the central upper area, then separate. After separation the blue object moves back toward the left side and the yellow object moves toward the upper right area. Both colored objects remain visible and appear still near the end.

reasons: The tabletop and two black edge objects are visible.
The blue and yellow moving objects are not yet visible in the first frame.
